meaning.enforced: Inspected publication-sensitive serving path has a publication tenant check; source assessment only.
meaning.affected: Supported omission or direct propagation from a supported omitted publication tenant check; pending fixes and regression evidence.
meaning.uncertain: Caller authorization, non-serving role, or some enumerated paths remain unadjudicated; not an assertion of vulnerability.
meaning.non-serving: Inspected graph/index/validation/storage helper does not project caller-facing publication output; this does not assess its callers.
meaning.privileged-boundary: An authenticated admin/scoped-admin policy gates the operation; finer tenant-target semantics remain an explicit gap.
meaning.resource-scoped: Inspected API intentionally authorizes a resource independently of publication presence; no publication-specific disclosure established. This is not an assertion that resource access hides all sibling publications.
meaning.binding-scoped: Internal reader helper pins the already resolved storage binding; built-in provider source/policy cannot redirect through an alternate publication. Caller authorization and custom providers remain separate responsibilities.

gaps: Regex inventory does not establish semantic exhaustiveness or cover dynamically generated code.
No scanner/runtime assurance from CSO helper; start failed SNAPSHOT_RACE.
Rows refer to pinned baseline, not uncommitted repair worktrees.
Admin/storage graph enumeration alone is not classified as a confidentiality defect.
